target.name: recorded property damage above zero
target.why: NOAA leaves DAMAGE_PROPERTY empty on 72,920 events and does not say that empty means none, so calling them negatives would invent that many labels

excluded_with_the_reason.EVENT_ID: an identifier, and an identifier is how a model memorises a row
excluded_with_the_reason.EPISODE_ID: the storm identifier, which is the thing the cuts exist to hide
excluded_with_the_reason.STATE: a categorical place label, undefined on an unseen state
excluded_with_the_reason.STATE_FIPS: the same label as a number
excluded_with_the_reason.WFO: the forecast office, which is a place label with another name
excluded_with_the_reason.CZ_NAME: the county or zone name, a finer place label
excluded_with_the_reason.CZ_FIPS: the same label as a number
excluded_with_the_reason.YEAR: no cut here is temporal, so a year effect cannot generalise to a later year
excluded_with_the_reason.DAMAGE_CROPS: recorded in the same pass as the property damage
excluded_with_the_reason.INJURIES_DIRECT: an outcome of the event, not known before it
excluded_with_the_reason.EVENT_NARRATIVE: it describes the damage in words
excluded_with_the_reason.EPISODE_NARRATIVE: it describes the storm in words

what_moves_between_these_two_arms: the test rows are different events
the share of rows whose damage field is absent differs between the cuts
the blocked training set holds none of the states the blocked test set holds

decomposition.note: the storm cut keeps the state mix and removes sibling events, so the first term is the episode half and the second is the cost of extrapolating into unseen states

matched.design: one evaluation set, one training size, sibling membership varied

shared_base_only.note: the leaky arm's base with no siblings added, so it is smaller than the other two on purpose and separates rows arriving from rows leaving

what_the_metric_values_rest_on: every count here re-derives from the committed artifacts and a check does it. the ranking metrics are a deterministic function of those artifacts, the feature allowlist and the seed, and two fits in one session agreed to four places. they are not verified across machines and a check cannot re-derive them without refitting, which is the measurement itself
